shared_elements: low-relief incised motifs on a weathered stone surface
curvilinear scroll or hook motifs within blocks
justification: Both are relief carvings on weathered stone in which motifs are contained within squarish framed cartouches with rounded internal scroll forms, and both show a roughly vertical arrangement of these units. However, A is a massive figural sculpture — a blocky head with headdress above a broad body bearing a large disc and banded belt, arranged as a single anthropomorphic composition — while B is a narrow columnar shaft covered by a regular grid of repeated small glyph-like blocks with no figural imagery, so the compositional logic and scale are quite different.
